text:
Tomas: CI blocked on release branch: typegen produced tiny API reorder in auth client, regen-diff non-empty. sample-apps failing publish. Anyone?
Lena: Seen that. It was the retry wrapper param ordering again (retryOptions optional props flip).
bot-regendiff: regendiff: packages/auth/src/client.ts modified (12 insertions, 9 deletions). Report: https://ci.redwood/regen/4999
Raj: Curious why changelog-maker put it as a minor. The change is purely reordering optional fields, should be patch.
Chloe: The changelog tool uses AST-level semantic change detection; it currently treats any signature change as breaking/refactor. We need heuristics for reorders of optional-only props.
Tomas: Repro: `git checkout release && ./dev/typegen --write && git diff -- src/client.ts` shows reorder of `{ maxRetries?: number; backoffMs?: number }` -> `{ backoffMs?: number; maxRetries?: number }`. No runtime behavior change.
Lena: Workaround: run `./scripts/normalize-type-order` that sorts optional props; works for TS but might not for Go/Rust outputs.
Raj: If we normalize only TS, we risk diverging SDK parity. Better solution: implement canonical ordering in codegen core (openapi->intermediate) so all targets inherit it.
Chloe: That core change is non-trivial and could touch many languages. Short-term we can relax the release gate: allow regen-diff if diff matches regex for optional-only reorders. But we need deterministic detection.
DevExOps: I can add a check that runs `regen-diff --format json` and validates all diffs are reorder-only using the new `--ignore-optional-reorder` matcher. I'll add the matcher behind a feature flag `regen_ignore_reorder`.
Tomas: Proposed plan: (1) Add matcher + gate change for this release (DevExOps), (2) Raj to prototype canonical ordering in openapi->IR (non-breaking), (3) Chloe to update changelog heuristic to treat optional-only reorders as patch.
Lena: I'll open a tiny hotfix branch `lena/normalize-retry-order` that runs the normalize script in the typegen poststep as a stopgap. Will include a golden file test.
Raj: I'll start a spike to add property sort at the IR level and run the SDK matrix. If it passes, we can roll it into next week's core change.
bot-ci: Started build 4999 for branch lena/normalize-retry-order. Jobs: unit, regen-check, publish-dryrun.
Chloe: Note: if we change changelog heuristics, update release playbook so product knows releases classified as patch won't accidentally bump minor.
DevExOps: Temporary relax deployed to release pipeline with label `allow-optional-reorder`. Will expire in 7 days.
Tomas: Thanks all. Once CI green I'll re-run sample-apps publish. If anyone sees client runtime mismatches in their integration tests, shout here.
Raj: Quick note: add an integration that compiles the TS client and runs a tiny retry scenario to ensure argument order doesn't matter at runtime (it shouldn't).
Chloe: Will do. Adding checklist item to the release notes. :white_check_mark:
Tomas: Closing for now, follow-ups in PRs.
